deque-mars.why: The social bar's 'Join the Conversation' link (#555 on the body's #344b6e) is at the right end of a 962px fixed-width container, past the 720px column and the light background image behind it. The page does the same at its own layout in a 720px window with no adapter: the same link, the same 1.18 contrast. Fitting it would mean overriding the page's fixed widths.

uw-before.why: The 11-column enrollment table cannot shrink below about 708px, and the white content box is 80% of the column (576px), so its last columns overhang onto the purple body. WCAG 1.4.10 exempts data tables from reflow; making it scroll would add a keyboard problem.

wikipedia.why: The navbox's horizontal link lists put two links within 24px of each other wherever a line wraps, so which two depends on the width: at its own layout the page has 8 target-size problems at 1280px, and in a 560px window with no adapter the same AccessiBe and Easy Chirp links are flagged. Any column that rewraps the lists moves the pair.
